ctx.x: I'd like somebody to tell us about when the band was in Denver and when Benny came back, had that tonsillectomy done by the surgeon here and what happened but anyway, let's start out with Benny Moten; what kind of a man he was, what kind of a band leader and musician and what your personal feelings were about the great Benny Moten. Baby, did you ever play for Benny Moten?
Oh, I've sit in his band. I've sit in. I never played with him. I never played with Benny Moten's band. I was with George Lee's band during the time Benny was famous around here.
Well you must have known him?
